references.text: The priest shall set the value for the one who has made a vow, based on what they can afford. This shows the priest's role in assessing values.
When someone dedicates their house to the Lord, the priest shall evaluate it as good or bad. The same principle of the priest's assessment applies.
Refers to evaluation between good and bad, using the same terminology applied to the priest's evaluation.
Describes valuation in shekels, showing the priest's role in assessing redemption value.
The priests shall teach the people the difference between holy and common, and between unclean and clean. This shows the priest's authority to distinguish and judge.
